messages:
opsbot: INCIDENT — Increased streaming tail latency detected in eu-embeddings cluster (eu-emb-1). Paging oncall @morgan. Investigating initial scope and impact.

morgan: Oncall ack. Looking at dashboards and logs now. Will triage and report back in ~10m.

devon: Thanks — any indication of customer impact yet? Hosted vs Dedicated?

morgan: Preliminary: elevated p95 latency for streaming completions, a small spike in 5xx for long-sequence requests. Dedicated pools appear unaffected so far. Correlating with recent small deploy tagged `release/2026-03-17-a`.

sam: @morgan can you drop an initial status update draft here? I can help polish for customers.

morgan: Draft below — open to edits:

`Investigating: We are seeing increased latency for streaming generation in the EU region affecting some hosted streaming and long-context embedding requests. Engineers are investigating the cause. We will provide updates every 20 minutes or as new information becomes available. No data loss expected.`

lia: Minor edits: call out region (eu-west1), scope = hosted streaming only, and list mitigation steps in progress. Keep customer wording minimal.

morgan: Updated draft:

```
Investigating — We are observing elevated tail latency for streaming generation in the EU (eu-west1). This is impacting hosted streaming completions and some embeddings requests with long sequences. Mitigations in progress: rolling back a recent deploy and routing affected traffic to an alternate EU pool. No data loss has been identified. Next update in 20 minutes or sooner if status changes.
```

devon: Routing suggestion: enable fallback routing policy so traffic goes from eu-primary -> eu-fallback automatically. @sre-ops can you prepare the flip and confirm commands?

sre-ops: Preparing routing flip now. ETA ~7m. Command we'll run: `rb-route set --pool eu-fallback --weight 100 --dry-run=false`. Will post back once executed and validated.

morgan: :thumbsup: I'll hold on publishing initial status page until routing is confirmed. Also prepping a short customer note for any active customers that may have seen errors.

customer-ops: Please avoid internal rollback details in the customer message. Focus on customer impact, what we did, and next steps. I can review before publish.

opsbot: Reminder scheduled — next auto-reminder at 1768505442 (20 minutes from initial).

sre-ops: Routing flip complete. Validation: 5xx rate down to baseline, p95 latency dropped ~40% on affected endpoints.

morgan: Publishing initial update now with the following monitoring text:

`Monitoring — We have rerouted traffic to an alternate EU pool and reverted a recent deploy. Error rates have decreased and latency is improving. Engineers continue to monitor.`

devon: Recommend adding: "No action required from customers."

morgan: Added and publishing. Also drafting resolved notice if metrics hold. Resolved draft:

`Resolved — We reverted the problematic deploy and routed traffic to a healthy pool. Metrics have returned to baseline and service is operating normally. If you continue to experience issues, please contact support@redwood.ai and include request IDs where available.`

customer-ops: LGTM. Please wait 10m to ensure stability before posting resolved.

morgan: Will wait and close thread when resolved published. Thanks all for fast responses.
